title: 第17章 指腹为婚第18章 传家玉佩
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第17章指腹为婚唐凝脑子轰一声，脸颊迅速晕染开一抹红晕，“我，我想起来，还没给公司发稿子，先去了……”
她急急忙忙起身，逃似地上了楼。
纪瑾修唇角不由自主上扬弧度。
可想到她刚刚打电话提到的离婚，眼底的笑意又消失黯淡。
唐凝回到卧室。
刚拿起手机，纪老爷子的电话打进来，“凝凝，这么久不见，爷爷想你了。”
“明天是你生日，爷爷做你爱吃的，你和纪寒一起回来吃饭。”
纪老爷子笑着，话里话外都是疼爱，“你这丫头，就喜欢围着纪寒转，自从前阵子你们领证后，也不回来看看爷爷，明天你们务必回来，爷爷想见见你。”
本来在纪念日领证的事，两家都知道的。
纪老爷子一直以为，他们已经成功登记了。
整个纪家里面，纪老爷子最喜欢唐凝。
唐凝想，有些事是时候面对了。
她答应下来，“好的爷爷，明天我一定回去。”
纪老爷子这才心满意足，唐凝跟他多聊了几句才挂电话，顺手点开纪寒最后发来的短信：
明天十点，民政局等你，我已经先退一步，你也别闹了。
唐凝皱了皱眉，陷入一阵自我怀疑，当初她是怎么爱上纪寒的？
她想得太过投入，没察觉到回了卧室的纪瑾修。
实际上她挂电话前几秒，他就已经进来了。
此刻唐凝的沉思在他看来，是因为这条短信的内容，而后悔跟他结了婚。
“纪太太。”

纪瑾修眸色暗了暗，嗓音凉薄，“世间没有后悔药，我可不想英年早离。”
唐凝被突如其来的声音吓一跳。
猛地回头看着纪瑾修，深呼吸好几下才调整过来，双眼满是怨念看着他。
这人走路没声的？
纪瑾修淡淡的声音再次响起，“至少目前，我没有离婚的打算。”
唐凝看着他冷峻的面容，俨然与这几日的温润体贴判若两人。
她可不想被误会，解释道：“我没想离婚。”
“嗯？”纪瑾修视线落在手机上，似乎在问她这算什么？
后悔的证据？
唐凝秒懂，“他发他的，影响不到我。”
她拿起笔记本电脑，眼神坦荡率直，“纪瑾修，婚姻的前提应该是信任。”
说完，唐凝抬脚走到床尾的沙发坐下，笔记本放在膝盖上，掀盖开机，骄傲的模样没再看他一眼。
纪瑾修晦暗的眼眸浮起抹异色，刚才唐凝那个骄傲的模样，已经许多年不复了。
十七岁前的唐凝，是圈子里出了名明媚自信的千金。
不知从什么时候开始，她变得患得患失，像个没有安全感的弃儿。
从此圈子里对她的风评变了，把善妒，任性，骄纵的标签扣在她头上。
久而久之，唐凝变得不再自信，更没了自信张扬的样子。
纪瑾修敛了思绪，来到她身旁，嗓音缓和轻柔，“抱歉，是我的问题。”
唐凝是个小爆竹，脾气易燃易爆。
可脾气来得快，去得也快。

她抬头扫了他一眼，嗯了声。
纪瑾修皱眉，只是嗯？
大小姐的脾气，还真是回来了。
纪瑾修深眸浮起笑意，“爷爷让你明天回去？”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Fingertips for Marriage Tang Ning's head went crazy, and a blush quickly spread on her cheeks, "I, I remembered, I haven't sent the manuscript to the company yet, so I went first..."
She stood up in a hurry and ran upstairs.
Ji Jinxiu's lips curved upward involuntarily.
But thinking about the divorce she just mentioned on the phone, the smile in her eyes disappeared again.
Tang Ning returned to the bedroom.
As soon as I picked up the phone, Mr. Ji called, "Ning Ning, it's been so long, grandpa misses you."
"Tomorrow is your birthday. Grandpa will cook your favorite food. You and Ji Han will come back for dinner together."
Mr. Ji smiled, his words full of love, "You girl, you just like to hang around Ji Han. Since you received the certificate a while ago, you haven't come back to see grandpa. You must come back tomorrow, grandpa wants to see you."
Originally, both families knew about getting the certificate on the anniversary.
Mr. Ji always thought that they had successfully registered.
Among the entire Ji family, Mr. Ji likes Tang Ning the most.
Tang Ning thought that it was time to face some things.
She agreed, "Okay grandpa, I will definitely go back tomorrow."
Mr. Ji was now satisfied. Tang Ning chatted with him for a few more words before hanging up the phone and opened the last text message from Ji Han:
Tomorrow at ten o'clock, the Civil Affairs Bureau will be waiting for you. I have already taken a step back, so please stop making trouble.
Tang Ning frowned and fell into self-doubt. How did she fall in love with Ji Han in the first place?
She was so immersed in her thoughts that she didn't notice Ji Jinxiu returning to the bedroom.
In fact, he had already entered a few seconds before she hung up the phone.
In his opinion, Tang Ning's contemplation at this moment was because she regretted marrying him because of the content of this text message.
"Mrs. Ji."
Ji Jinxiu's eyes darkened and his voice was cold, "There is no regret medicine in this world. I don't want to die young."
Tang Ning was startled by the sudden sound.
He suddenly looked back at Ji Jinxiu, took several deep breaths to adjust, and looked at him with eyes filled with resentment.
Does this person walk silently?
Ji Jinxiu's faint voice sounded again, "At least for now, I have no plans to divorce."
Tang Ning looked at his stern face, which seemed completely different from the gentle and considerate person he had been in the past few days.
She didn't want to be misunderstood, so she explained: "I don't want to get divorced."
"Huh?" Ji Jinxiu's eyes fell on the mobile phone, as if asking her what was this?
Evidence of regret?
Tang Ning understood instantly, "What he sent him won't affect me."
She picked up her laptop and said with a candid look, "Ji Jinxiu, the prerequisite for marriage should be trust."
After saying that, Tang Ning walked to the sofa at the end of the bed and sat down. She put her notebook on her knees, opened it and turned it on. She looked proud and didn't look at him again.
Ji Jinxiu's gloomy eyes had a strange look. The proud look Tang Ning had just now had not been seen for many years.
Before the age of seventeen, Tang Ning was known in the circle as a bright and confident daughter.
I don't know when she started to worry about gains and losses, like an abandoned child with no sense of security.
From then on, the reputation of her in the circle changed, and she was labeled as jealous, willful, and arrogant.
Over time, Tang Ning became less confident, let alone confident and assertive.
Ji Jinxiu collected his thoughts and came to her side. His voice was soft and gentle, "Sorry, it's my problem."
Tang Ning is a little firecracker with a flammable and explosive temper.
But temper comes and goes quickly.
She raised her head and glanced at him, humming.
Ji Jinxiu frowned, just hmm?
The eldest lady's temper has really come back.
Ji Jinxiu's deep eyes revealed a smile, "Grandpa wants you to go back tomorrow?"
